name: DDRK step-count overrides
plain: Rules that change the requested settings based on step count and model family. Some of them run even with auto off, and the code prints a message saying so. Below is what actually fires.
math:
Flow, auto on: steps≤10 → SABER 0, SDE 0, momentum 0, sharp≤.12, auto→hc2. Steps≤20 → SABER≤.05, SDE 0, momentum≤.10, sharp≤.15.
Any mode: steps≤6 and integrator not hc2/hc3 → euler. EDM steps≤10 and rk4 → heun.
Phase split: p1≥60%, p2≤22% EDM; p1≤55%, p2≥35% flow. Auto picks: phase 1 by curvature (>.15 and ≥10 steps rk4; >.05 heun; else hc2); with no previous x0 yet, flow ≥10 steps rk4 if σ>.3σmax else heun, otherwise heun. Phase 2 heun if ≥8 steps else euler, phase 3 hc2.
label: from code

audit.note: sampler.py:1024-1042: curvature picks only apply once state.prev_denoised exists. Before that, phase 1 auto uses a sigma rule, which the math omits.
